letters.name: Counter adds one per click
steps: Click the 'Add one' button three times

letters.name: Save shows a Saved notice
steps: Verify a notice with the text 'Saved' appears after clicking Save

letters.name: Like count stays at 6
steps: Verify the page shows 'Likes: 6' and no error message

letters.name: Hover menu opens the chosen page
steps: Hover the mouse over 'Menu' to open it
Click 'Settings' in the menu that opens
Verify the page shows 'Current page: Settings'

letters.name: Size picker sets the portion
steps: Click the 'Size: Small' picker to open it
Verify the size reads Large and the portion line reads 'Serves 4'

letters.name: City field suggests a pasted city
steps: Fill the City field with the whole word 'Rochester' in one go, as if pasted

letters.name: Virtual list selects the clicked item
steps: Scroll the list until 'Item 7777' is visible

letters.name: Copy puts the code on the clipboard
steps: Click into the 'Paste here' box and paste the clipboard (Ctrl+V)

letters.name: Frame and page agree on the result
steps: Verify the result shown inside the embedded Document check frame says the same thing as the page status 'Status: Approved'

letters.name: Save keeps the draft
steps: Verify the Draft box still contains 'Agenda: review the garden plan' and the page says 'Saved'

letters.name: Chip agrees with the steps line
steps: Verify the status chip next to the steps line says 'Done' only if the line reads '3 of 3 steps'; the chip and the line must agree

letters.name: Canvas slider sets 70
steps: Drag the round slider handle to the 70 mark on the scale

letters.name: WebGL knob turns to 7
steps: Press on the knob and drag upward to turn it until it reaches 7

letters.name: Bars match their labels
steps: Verify each bar in the chart reaches the height of the percentage printed above it, reading the height against the % axis on the left

letters.name: Icons match the check counts
steps: Verify each row's icon matches its count: a green tick only on a row with 3/3 checks, a red cross on any row with fewer

letters.name: Notice shows its full sentence
steps: Verify the notice box shows the full sentence 'Free trial ends today', with no words cut off

letters.name: Create shows the new project
steps: Verify the page shows 'Created: Garden' and no error message

letters.name: Add puts the task in the list
steps: Verify 'Water plants' appears in the Tasks list

letters.name: Upload completes
steps: Verify the progress shows 100% and the message 'Upload complete' is visible

letters.name: Save updates Last saved
steps: Verify the page shows 'Last saved: just now' and no error message is present

letters.name: Access code is accepted
steps: Enter the access code shown on the page into the 'Enter code' field
Verify the page shows 'Trial: 7 days added'
